build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with obstacle bars and a dynamic ball using creator_lib
create_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle with configurable scale, position, and angle in the scene
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object positioned on top of an obstacle in the scene
update_task_relationships: update the task to define a TOUCHING spatial relationship between the ball and bottom wall
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.TWO_BALLS for the PHYRE puzzle
